name: Continue?
clause: Choose up to four target creature cards in your graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.

needs.semantics: Matches a card in a graveyard that was put there from the battlefield during the current turn. The engine already counts `creatures-died-this-turn`, so this needs a per-object record of the turn and origin zone of its last move, cleared at cleanup, read by matchesFilter and by legal.ts when the targets are offered.
